subject: Praxis Health — AWS co-sell kickoff / intro request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Praxis Health — quick sync / AWS co-sell intro request

Hi Ben / Laura,

Quick heads-up: Praxis Health (payer-tech startup, ~900 employees) asked for an AWS co-sell introduction to evaluate Redwood for a customer-facing generative search and summarization feature. They are coming from an existing on-prem NLP stack and are specifically asking that an AWS AM join the kickoff to talk about marketplace listing and co-sell paths.

Why this matters: Praxis is a strong fit for a marketplace + co-sell play — they have a procurement rhythm (SaaS PO approved) and a potential mid-Q4 proof-of-concept. AWS indicated they can co-sell if we align on an MOU and a joint account plan.

What I need from you both:
- Ben: can you own the technical narrative + 20-minute product walk (demo & architecture sketch)?
- Laura: can you prepare the commercial/marketplace checklist and flag any procurement hurdles (SLA/PEM/KYC) and own the SOW draft we can share?

I plan to intro the AWS AM (Taylor Nguyen) and the Praxis contact (Emma Perez) — proposing a 30–45m kickoff next week. Suggested times below (PDT):
- Tue 8/8 10:00–10:45
- Wed 8/9 14:00–14:45
- Thu 8/10 09:00–09:45

If those work, I will send the intro and include the attached draft SOW and a short joint-play deck for AWS.

Thanks — want to get alignment before I loop in AWS/Emma.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Platform Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: praxis_sow_draft.pdf (stub), redwood-aws-joint-play.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Aug 2028 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Praxis Health — quick sync / AWS co-sell intro request

On Fri, Aug 4, 2028 at 09:03 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick heads-up: Praxis Health (payer-tech startup, ~900 employees) asked for an AWS co-sell introduction...

Thanks for the context. I can take the demo — will prepare a 15–20m product + integration run-through focused on:
- data flow and privacy (no PHI leaves their VPC),
- expected token budgets for search+summaries,
- recommended model/quantization profile for cost parity.

I prefer Wed 8/9 14:00 PDT. Also will prepare a short tech pre-read (1 slide + architecture diagram).

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Perez <emma.perez@praxishealth.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed kickoff times — Redwood x Praxis (AWS co-sell)

Emma / Taylor — looping you both in.

Emma, great speaking with you last week — excited to explore how Redwood can help Praxis deliver summarization and search across clinical documents while controlling inference cost. Taylor, thanks for offering to join this initial conversation — Praxis would love to understand the marketplace and co-sell options early.

Proposed 30–45m kickoff (PDT):
- Wed 8/9 14:00–14:45
- Thu 8/10 09:00–09:45
- Fri 8/11 11:00–11:45

Agenda (high level):
1) Intros & goals (5m)
2) Product demo + integration pattern (15–20m) — Ben Carter
3) Marketplace / procurement path & co-sell mechanics — Taylor (AWS) + Laura (Redwood) (10m)
4) Next steps: SOW, timeline, trial access (5–10m)

Attached: praxis_sow_draft.pdf (SOW skeleton), redwood-aws-joint-play.pdf (short playbook). Please let us know which time works best and whether anyone else from Praxis (security/compliance or platform) should join.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Platform Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: praxis_sow_draft.pdf, redwood-aws-joint-play.pdf

From: Emma Perez <emma.perez@praxishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Aug 2028 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed kickoff times — Redwood x Praxis (AWS co-sell)

Hi Soojin / Taylor,

Thanks for the intro. Wed 8/9 14:00 PDT works for us — I'll include our Director of Platform, Maya Thomas, and our Compliance lead, Aaron Cole. Maya will want to review the integration pattern and Aaron will want a short note on data residency & logging.

Can you share a 1-page technical pre-read and the SOW skeleton ahead of the meeting? Also, do you have an initial estimate for token volumes for a 3-week pilot? That will help us size the trial.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Emma Perez
Director of Product, Praxis Health
emma.perez@praxishealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Perez <emma.perez@praxishealth.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed kickoff times — Redwood x Praxis (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Emma — great, Wed 8/9 14:00 PDT is confirmed. Calendar invite (placeholder) sent.

Ben: flagging Maya and Aaron from Praxis — can you include a simple pre-read with:
- 1-slide architecture (data ingress, VPC options, KV caching)
- 1 slide on estimated token budget for a 3-week 10k-user pilot (ballpark)

Laura: if you can share the SOW skeleton publicly ahead of the call, that will help expedite procurement (I've attached the two docs again).

Taylor: can you confirm if an AWS co-sell MOU or channel acknowledgement is needed before we proceed with a marketplace trial? If there are any AWS docs we should prep, let us know.

Action items:
- Ben: tech pre-read (today EOD)
- Laura: public SOW skeleton (today EOD)
- Taylor: confirm co-sell prerequisites (when convenient)

Thanks everyone — see you Wed.

— Soojin

Platform Sales, Redwood Inference
